225-4477-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
225-4477-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Greenwarden of Murasa and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Greenwarden of Murasa and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
225-4477-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Greenwarden of Murasa and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

215-1849-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Forests.
215-1849-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Rofellos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rofellos by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

876-4188-7070.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
876-4188-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Accomplished Alchemist.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Accomplished Alchemist.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Accomplished Alchemist.
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Accomplished Alchemist.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Accomplished Alchemist.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

1308-2034-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1308-2034-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1171-1409-7296.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

4585-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Custodi Soulbinders.
When Custodi Soulbinders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

628-5231-7200.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Reluctant Dounguard.
When Reluctant Dounguard dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

1456-3459-5078-6723.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

38-2173-5220-6273.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2645-3053-3918.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two basic land types among lands you control
2645-3053-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color(s).
Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-3053-3918.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.

3918-4038-6700.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sarevok's Tome's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

3464-3657-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Bighorner Rancher.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
3464-3657-5614.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can repeat steps 2-5 infinitely to untap any other creature(s)

1339-2122-3334-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-3334-4050.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {1}.
Repeat.

907-1399-1606-5929.description:
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Selesnya Sanctuary.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

224-1772-4826-5621.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

1029-5028-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Forests.
1029-5028-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Rofellos.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-5028-5709.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

2034-4311-5043-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

488-641-2478-4708-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Dark Sphere or Mishra's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-2478-4708-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2034-2835-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2034-2835-6249--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the persist creature dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

225-774-3756.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1533-2051-2546-3872.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
1533-2051-2546-3872.description:
Activate Secluded Steppe's cycling ability by paying {W} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Secluded Steppe ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Land's Edge by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Land's Edge ability, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{W}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Secluded Steppe and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1278-1379-1651-4508.notablePrerequisites:
Lightning-Rig Crew does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two opponents.
1278-1379-1651-4508.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Lightning-Rig Crew.
Repeat until you have one or less opponent remaining.

1325-2074-4417-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites: Vorapede does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1325-2074-4417-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Vorapede.
Vorapede dies, triggering itself, Kheru Bloodsucker, and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Vorapede trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Kheru Bloodsucker trigger, causing each opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain two life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Vorapede's power.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}, two life and removing the +1/+1 counter from Vorapede, giving Hex Parasite +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2510-4929-5224.notablePrerequisites:
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You have a creature card exiled by Semblance Anvil.
2510-4929-5224.description:
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Cryptic Trilobite dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Together Forever triggers, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Cryptic Trilobite, choosing one for {X}, but paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat.

570-901-2024.notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
570-901-2024.description:
During your upkeep, activate Govern the Guildless by paying {1}{U} and revealing it from your hand, making a creature you control all colors until end of turn.
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{W}{G}, giving Faeburrow Elder +3/+3 until end of turn and untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
